description: SLA math in working hours: the deadline N business hours after a start time, or business time elapsed between two times. Use for support-ticket SLAs, response-time targets and office-hours deadlines. Custom hours and workdays, holidays, country public holidays, DST-aware. First 25 calls per day are free, then $0.001 per call (x402).

inputSchema.description: Pass "hours"/"minutes" to get a deadline, or "end" to count business time between start and end.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (207 countries); its public holidays (2000–2050) are excluded from business days

end.description: Count business time from start to end (max 1 year)

start.description: Local datetime in timezone or ISO 8601 with offset; default now

name: business_hours_deadline
title: Business-hours deadline / SLA
